observations.says: at half past ten on Thursday, the bundle was tied with the carrick bend
from seven o'clock on Thursday until eleven o'clock on Thursday, Tom Pike was at the Bell
Sam Rudd knew the carrick bend
Ellen did not know the carrick bend
the carrick bend was held to be a seaman's knot, which a landsman does not tie
from seven o'clock on Thursday until eleven o'clock on Thursday, Sam Rudd was at Fernleigh
